k.hero-02: The art of hosting, in the mountains.
k.hero-03: We prepare your stays in Embrun, Les Orres and Crévoux, and look after the houses and apartments of those who rent them out. One team, on site, winter and summer alike.
k.seasons-04: Skis delivered, lift passes ready, chalet warmed up for your arrival in Les Orres or Crévoux.
k.seasons-07: Serre-Ponçon, white water and high-altitude trails, from Embrun and Savines.
k.home-03: Groceries, skis and passes, transfers, private chef: you arrive, the rest is taken care of.
k.home-07: Check-in, cleaning, linen and follow-up: three packages, or services à la carte.
k.voyageurs-03: Renting a place in the valley? Tell us what you need and we take care of the rest with our local partners: ski rental shops, chefs, taxis, instructors.
k.voyageurs-05: Your groceries delivered before you arrive, or during your stay. A basket of local produce from the Champsaur and Embrunais on request.
k.voyageurs-07: Skis and lift passes at your door
k.voyageurs-08: Equipment fitted and dropped off at your place, passes collected for the whole family. You head straight to the chairlift.
k.voyageurs-09: Rental shop price, free or low-cost delivery
k.voyageurs-11: The Paris-Briançon night train stops in Embrun. A driver waits for you on the platform and takes you to Les Orres or Crévoux.
k.voyageurs-14: A private chef for an end-of-stay dinner, a caterer, or raclette delivered with its grill.
k.voyageurs-17: Travel cot, high chair and baby bath set up before you arrive. Childcare by trusted people.
k.voyageurs-20: A massage after a day on the slopes, private lessons, paragliding above the lake, boat trips in summer.
k.proprietaires-03: Do you rent out your apartment or chalet during the season? We welcome your guests, prepare the property between stays and keep an eye on it when the resort is closed. You receive a photo report after every visit.
k.proprietaires-08: A contact you can reach during the stay
k.proprietaires-16: Small issues fixed on the spot
k.proprietaires-17: Flat fee per stay based on sizeOn quotation
k.proprietaires-20: Listing, photos and prices adjusted to the season
k.proprietaires-26: For owners who manage their own bookings, or on top of a package. Cleaning and linen are usually charged to the guest in the listing.
k.proprietaires-35: Snow clearing of access and balcony
k.proprietaires-44: We come to see the property and listen to what you expect.
k.proprietaires-46: Photos, inventory, welcome booklet, set of keys.
k.proprietaires-48: Welcome, cleaning, linen and follow-up at every turnover.
k.proprietaires-50: Monthly statement and off-season inspection visits.
k.territoire-03: We are based in the Embrunais. Les Orres and Crévoux are about twenty minutes away by road, so we can be there quickly, even on a Saturday in February.
k.territoire-06: The town, the station and Lake Serre-Ponçon. Our base, summer and winter.
k.territoire-09: The valley's major resort, with its residences and chalets.
k.territoire-12: An unspoilt village, a family resort and its large chalets.
k.territoire-15: The Forêt Blanche ski area, about forty minutes away. Write to us if your property is there.
k.promise-01: A single point of contact who knows your home and the valley.
k.promise-03: A team that lives here, not a call centre.
k.promise-05: Reply within two hours in season, from 8 am to 9 pm.
k.promise-07: A photo report after every visit, a clear statement every month.
k.promise-09: Partners chosen in the valley: craftsmen, rental shops, producers.
k.contact-02: Let's talk about your stay, or your property.
k.contact-03: Describe what you need in a few lines. We reply personally, with a tailored proposal.
k.footer-02: Private concierge · Embrun · Les Orres · Crévoux
